title: Cu/Au-doped nanopolymers with multiple catalytic activities for NIR II laser-promoted nanocatalytic tumor therapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11893-11901
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08591D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xixi Wu, Xiang Feng, Peng Yu, Jing Zhang, Rui Liu
A novel nanocatalyst based on Cu/Au-doped polypyrrole has been synthesized for NIR II laser-promoted nanocatalytic tumor therapy through several enhanced catalytic mechanisms, including elevated temperature and electron migration.
